user_operations: Plug original battery connector into board with correct polarity
Seat battery and board in insulated supports without loading connector
Inspect seating and wire clearance before adhesive closure

measurements_required.needed: Maximum width including side ears, depth, height and position relative to header PCB pads; include mated tolerances
measurements_required.why: 3.8mm main body width excludes protrusions and cannot establish clearance

measurements_required.needed: Insulated flexible length between pack strain relief and housing exit for all three conductors, shortest and longest supplied condition
measurements_required.why: Published 15+/-3mm is pack-to-housing drawing dimension, not free wire length

measurements_required.needed: Wire outside diameter, exit locations and directions, allowable bend radius, strain relief length
measurements_required.why: A center-to-center straight distance omits bends and terminal strain

measurements_required.needed: Check premating outside case, full seating inspection, then insertion with no pinch or tension
measurements_required.why: Collision-free final pose alone does not establish user assembly

measurements_required.needed: A1 mini PLA 0.4mm fit sample, measured walls/stops and adhesive intrusion
measurements_required.why: Nominal CAD does not establish printed clearance

acceptance: Original battery and original connector remain unmodified
Full connector engagement is visible before closure
No lead is trapped between PCB, separator, stops or case seam
Battery support carries load without pressing on connector or components
Specified minimum bend radius and strain relief are satisfied throughout assembly
Five prototype assemblies document actual dimensions and photos; variation beyond sampled units remains bounded by supplier tolerances
not_proven: Electrical polarity and battery-protection verification are separate from geometric fit
No full plug or lead model is present; do not call current assembled STEP complete
Clearance applies only to the modeled battery body in its final pose; original harness, mating plug and assembly sweep are excluded.
Integrated board models are not guaranteed maximum component envelopes; printed tolerance and battery retention load are not validated.
fit_risk: Nominal longitudinal clearance is only 0.05mm per end at the modeled maximum battery length. Printed dimensional error, adhesive intrusion and insertion margin are unqualified; zero CAD intersection is not assembly approval.
